posts.cooked:
Hey folks! 
 
Love board games? (obviously, this a forum for an amazing board game publisher)
 
Love food? (again, that's pretty obviously a yes. I mean, you'd need some form of caloric intake to have the energy required to read and decipher this...)
 
Want a place to exist where you can game and consume tasty treats? Then you should take this survey to help a start-up company get their marketing research done...
 
https://www.surveymonkey.com/s/WGXBDVM
 
Completing this survey and spreading it around helps a company get started in Central Florida (right between Disney and Busch Gardens) that grants visitors access to an extensive board game library and delicious food.
 
 
Thanks a million!
D-Lo
